questions.stem:
Match List-I with List-II.
List-I (Partial Derivatives) | List-II (Thermodynamic Quantity)
(A) $\left(\frac{\partial G}{\partial T}\right)_{P}$ | (I) $C_{P}$
(B) $\left(\frac{\partial H}{\partial T}\right)_{P}$ | (II) $-S$
(C) $\left(\frac{\partial G}{\partial P}\right)_{T}$ | (III) $C_{V}$
(D) $\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T}\right)_{V}$ | (IV) $V$
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
(A) $dG = VdP - SdT$
Constant pressure
$dG = -SdT$
$\left(\frac{\partial G}{\partial T}\right)_{P} = -S$
(B) $dH = (dq)_{P} = nC_{p}dT$
$\left(\frac{\partial H}{\partial T}\right)_{P} = C_{P}$
(C) $dG = VdP - SdT$
At constant temperature
$dG = VdP$
$\left(\frac{\partial G}{\partial P}\right)_{T} = V$
(D) $dU = nC_{v}dT = (q)_{V}$
$\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T}\right)_{V} = C_{V}$

questions.stem:
Consider the following cases of standard enthalpy of reaction ($\Delta H_{r}^{\circ}$ in $\mathrm{kJ\ mol^{-1}}$)
$\mathrm{C_2H_6(g) + \frac{7}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow 2CO_2(g) + 3H_2O(\ell)}\quad \Delta H_{1}^{\circ} = -1550$
$\mathrm{C(graphite) + O_2(g) \rightarrow CO_2(g)}\quad \Delta H_{2}^{\circ} = -393.5$
$\mathrm{H_2(g) + \frac{1}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow H_2O(\ell)}\quad \Delta H_{3}^{\circ} = -286$
The magnitude of $\Delta H_{f}^{\circ}\ \mathrm{C_2H_6(g)}$ is ______ $\mathrm{kJ\ mol^{-1}}$ (Nearest integer).
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{2C_{(graphite)} + 3H_2(g) \rightarrow C_2H_6(g)}\quad \Delta H_{f} = ?$
$\mathrm{C_2H_6(g) + \frac{7}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow 2CO_2(g) + 3H_2O(l)}\quad \Delta H_{1} = -1550$
$\mathrm{C_{(graphite)} + O_2(g) \rightarrow CO_2(g)}\quad \Delta H_{2} = -393.5$
$\mathrm{H_2(g) + \frac{1}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow H_2O(l)}\quad \Delta H_{3} = -286$
$\Delta H_{f} = 2\Delta H_{2} + 3\Delta H_{3} - \Delta H_{1}$
$= 95$ kJ/mole.
